notes: All 44 pieces from the parts list are included (counts match per type and colour).
Booklet images are small; exact stud positions and some attachments (exhaust arms, headlight tiles, bar, brush and shovel clips, trash can mounting) are best-guess interpretations.

Piece assignments by step: 1 base + clip plate; 2 brick + plate; 3 lime brick + second clip brick; 4 two sloped bricks; 5 green plates; 6-7 cargo box walls and round lime plates; 8 exhaust arms; 9 seat, 4083 bar, bracket; 10 headlights and grille; 11 steering stand and cone; 12 bar; 13 brush; 14 shovel, brown round plates, trash cans with lids; 15 four wheels with tyres.
The minifigure shown in step 15 is not in the parts list and is not recorded.
